string.text: I have a very special contact who is offering a huge reward for taking down ten stalkers. 250.000, plus sweets. Sounds like great cash for a simple list of bounties, right? Here's the interesting part: your targets just happen to be the top ten stalkers in the entire Zone. This means you could be hunting down regulars, Dutyers, mercs or even the fucking Monolith themselves! You can see the list on your PDA if you want. This guy wants them dead, doesn't matter how.
